description: The assignment of replacement-term values for one-variable substitution is the original assignment updated at that variable with the replacement term's value.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.singleSubst_assignment.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} [DecidableEq α] (t : L.Term α) (x : α) (a : α → M) :
  (fun y => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize a (if y = x then t else FirstOrder.Language.var y)) =
    Function.update a x (FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize a t)
